hints.title: Sliding Window Stream Buffer
hints.text: Maintain the sliding window of the last m elements using a sequential buffer.

hints.title: Maintaining Distribution and Partial Sums
hints.text: maintain the distribution of elements in the window using binary indexed trees or balanced search trees.

hints.title: Binary Lifting for Rank Queries
hints.text: with two Fenwick trees (one for frequencies, one for values sum), find the k-th smallest element and (m-k)-th smallest element in O(log max_val) time, subtract both k-element tails, and divide by m - 2k.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(log C) per add and calculate
complexity.notes: Fenwick trees maintain frequency counts and prefix sums with rank binary lifting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the last m elements on each query takes O(m log m) time, resulting in time limit exceeded with frequent queries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual Fenwick trees track frequencies and partial sums in O(log C) per add and calculate, where C = 100,000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should maintain sliding window order and efficiently balance partitions or use binary indexed tree rank lifting.
